summary_1line: Ravana’s titan allies urge him to wage war, recounting his past conquests over gods, serpents, and kings to inflame his pride.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana sits on his throne while ranks of titans with folded palms praise his past victories and urge him toward war.
Ravana battling the serpent kings Vasuki and Takshaka in the depths of the netherworld amid coiling serpents.
Ravana descending into the dark ocean realm to confront the sons of Varuna as waves and sea creatures swirl around him.
